title: Restricted Standard WOFOST One-Day Structural Evolution Candidate
goal: Implement the smallest production state-integration seam for one standard actual-WOFOST crop day without migrating the complete WOFOST rate evaluator in the same unit.

persistent_physical_state: existing actual biomass and active LV/SLA/LVAGE cohorts
optional common evolution continuation: TSUM, fl_anthesis, nofd, atmin7[7]
reference_compatibility_state: optional B1.10 GLAIEXP carryover sidecar only after the LAIEXP threshold requires it
event_local_inputs: minimal event-local rate packet produced by a later qualified rate evaluator

transaction_rules: prepare starts from caller-supplied crop checkpoint and mutates only a candidate
day-start nofd/atmin7 updates never mutate committed state directly
finalize produces a complete candidate owner state and never commits it
F-KT remains the only publication/rollback authority
same checkpoint plus same forcing, aggregates, parameters and rate packet must replay bitwise identically
discarded candidate must leave the checkpoint bitwise unchanged
temporal_rules: t0 and t1 are explicit real-valued kernel times
initial structural seam admits only t1-t0 equal to one day
no midnight, daynr or t1900 dependency is allowed
exactly one leaf cohort is inserted per admitted crop event even when its biomass increment is zero
multiple Richards substeps inside the crop day do not invoke additional crop shifts
reference_rules: RELTR follows B1.10: 1 when |IPTRA_WINDOW| < 1e-10, otherwise clamp(IQROT_WINDOW/IPTRA_WINDOW,0,1)
if pre-event LAIEXP < 6, the supplied event-local GLAIEXP is used and captured if the updated state enters the carryover regime
if pre-event LAIEXP >= 6, the structural seam uses the stored B1.10 carryover and fails closed when that sidecar is absent
silent reset of GLAIEXP at the threshold is forbidden
qualification_boundary: F-WOF26 can qualify the structural state integrator only. It must not claim full standard-WOFOST production physics until a separate source-bound rate evaluator is implemented and qualified.
